roofs.note: Steep lower slopes from each side's wall to the flat at 35.9 (roof plan, elevations): the north face meets the flat on x 105.5 (roof plan) from its eave at 18.9 (north elevation). Open over the Texas deck (its pavilion covers it) and where the south-east gable's south slope is the roof.

One ridge at 43.3 the length of the main block, z 47.4 (south elevation's gable peak, the attic plan's framed strip, section B-B); both slopes at the west roof's pitch (1.515, west elevation) from the cornice at 28.0 a foot out; the east slope meets the flat at 35.9 on z 52.3 (the roof plan's line).

Seven arched windows under a low hipped roof, back into the main roof.

The Texas deck's roof: one octagonal pavilion over the tower's top and the well, its point at x 57.2, z 64.8 and its eave octagon 20.7 ft across flats (roof plan), cut square on the top hall's wall; eave 34.7, point 37.1 (east elevation).

An octagonal spire over the alcove's deck, centred where the roof plan and section A-A put its point (x 73.2, z 37.2, over the house's west wall), its eave octagon 17.4 ft across flats (roof plan); eave 33.2 and point 47.25 (the south elevation's mark, PEAK OF ROOF 47'-3"). Its inner half dies into the long roof in valleys.
